name: @serfab/test-harness
description: Repo-root test infrastructure shared by several packages' suites, imported by relative path rather than as a dependency. Deliberately NOT a yarn workspace (the root `workspaces` glob is `packages/*`) and deliberately not built: a compiled shared package would be consumed from its own `dist`, which is the exact staleness failure build-freshness.ts exists to catch. This manifest exists only to mark the directory as ES modules, which the root package.json does not.
